name: CompoundBrief — API on RapidAPI
description:
Build a compound brief for a batch of drug names in one call: CompoundBrief returns the ChEMBL molecule record, bioactivity footprint and Crossref literature footprint together, so early research triage starts from one consistent brief instead of three tabs.

What you get:
- ChEMBL molecule record per compound: identifiers, structure metadata and activity counts
- Bioactivity record counts and a literature footprint from Crossref
- Name matching against ChEMBL preferred names — if a name does not resolve, the brief says so and suggests the preferred form (for example, search acetaminophen, not paracetamol)
- Batch briefs in one response with a summary

Key endpoints:
- POST /brief/batch — brief up to 25 compounds in one call
- POST /brief/single — brief one compound
- GET /health — service status

Plans: BASIC is free with 200 calls per month. PRO is $9/month for 10,000 calls. ULTRA is $29/month for 50,000 calls plus $0.001 per additional call.

Access: subscribe on RapidAPI (free tier available); calls are made over HTTPS with your RapidAPI key.
